name: @floor/api
description: The Floor's HTTP API (docs/api_sketch.md) and its own event loop: the single-instance-leased process that turns node.<id>.start, station_run.reported, internal.*, schedule ticks and start.on events into AssemblyRunStore calls. Holds no provider client; every worker (the cluster agent, a service station) pulls its own work from the queue this process serves over /events/claim.
